name: Aisyah binti Rahman
bio:
Aisyah developed a passion for motorsport early, influenced by her father's involvement in local rally racing. She pursued a degree in Materials Engineering, specializing in composite materials, and began her career at a local aerospace company. Seeking a more dynamic environment, she transitioned to motorsport five years ago, initially assisting a GT team with carbon fiber repairs and aerodynamic enhancements. Aisyah's meticulous approach and adaptability quickly earned her recognition. She excels at problem-solving under pressure and is known for her innovative solutions to complex composite-related challenges, particularly in weight reduction strategies without compromising structural integrity.

Aisyah believes in continuous learning and stays abreast of the latest advancements in composite technology. She is dedicated to optimizing performance and reliability and is eager to contribute her expertise to a forward-thinking team. Her collaborative spirit makes her a valuable asset, fostering a positive and productive work environment. She approaches every project with a keen eye for detail and is committed to delivering exceptional results.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Aisyah has a warm smile and a focused gaze, conveying both competence and approachability.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a collection of miniature racing car models on her workbench.
Prefers to listen to traditional Malaysian music while working to maintain focus.
